notes.title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion launches later this year!
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes!

Tribute Games, Dotemu, and Marvel Games assemble today to announce MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, an arcade-style beat ‘em up featuring an incredible roster of characters from Marvel’s golden eras!

Catch a first glimpse of the cosmic adventure awaiting you later this year in our announcement trailer:

[previewyoutube=19_uUhZsjsg;full][ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER LINK][/previewyoutube]
A Cosmic Battle awaits!
After Annihilus has launched an unprecedented attack across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance. Nova, Spider-Man, Wolverine, Phyla-Vell, Captain America, and many more heroes, both earth-born and cosmic, will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave.

Get ready to brawl through the streets of New York City and all the way to the depths of the Negative Zone to foil Annihilus’ plan to spread death across the cosmos!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558595/665ec4ff6536837f0d341d844d34f13d6b4b5ca4.png
Assemble your team to face the Annihilation Wave!
In MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, choose from 15 of Marvel’s greatest Super Heroes to create your own team of two characters and fight against the intergalactic conqueror Annihilus!
Tag between them mid-fight with the innovative Cosmic Swap system, and capitalize on each character’s abilities to create unique combos and powerful special attacks! 
With its dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a true love letter to the Marvel Universe!

MARVEL Cosmic Invasion’s action will support four-player drop-in/drop-out local and online co-op with crossplay!

From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the fate of the universe will be fought for across the stars!

Wishlist MARVEL Cosmic Invasion NOW!
